description: Manage the Apple devices your organization owns: find devices, assign them to your device management service, release them, check AppleCare and Activation Lock, and add them to Blueprints. Start a workflow when a device is added, assigned, unassigned, released or erased.

apple_business_manager_device_assigned_t.description: Runs when a device is assigned to a device management service (MDM server), by a person, an API account or Apple. Needs the API account's role to include audit events.

output.device_name: The device's name, when Apple gives one
output.done_by: Who did it: a person, an API account or Apple
output.serial_number: The device's serial number, for the device actions
output.service_name: The service it was assigned to

parameters.description: Only devices assigned to this service. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: service_id

apple_business_manager_device_erased_tri.description: Runs when a device in your organization is erased. Needs the API account's role to include audit events.

output.device_name: The device's name, when Apple gives one
output.done_by: Who did it: a person, an API account or Apple
output.serial_number: The device's serial number, for the device actions

apple_business_manager_device_released_t.description: Runs when a device is released from your organization, by a person, a device management service, a reseller or an API account. Needs the API account's role to include audit events.

output.device_name: The device's name, when Apple gives one
output.done_by: Who did it: a person, an API account or Apple
output.released_by: Who released it: USER, MDM, RESELLER, API or REPLACEMENT
output.serial_number: The device's serial number, for the device actions

apple_business_manager_device_unassigned.description: Runs when a device is unassigned from its device management service. Needs the API account's role to include audit events.

output.device_name: The device's name, when Apple gives one
output.done_by: Who did it: a person, an API account or Apple
output.serial_number: The device's serial number, for the device actions

apple_business_manager_new_device_trigge.description: Runs when a device is added to your organization, such as a new Mac from an order or one added with Apple Configurator. Devices already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.device: Everything Apple says about the device
output.product_family: Mac, iPhone, iPad, iPod, AppleTV, Watch or Vision
output.serial_number: The device's serial number, for the device actions
output.status: ASSIGNED or UNASSIGNED to a device management service

parameters.description: Only this kind of device: Mac, iPhone, iPad, iPod, AppleTV, Watch or Vision. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: product_family
